crossRefs.note: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to…
For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you…
Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as…
Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

translations.web: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?
translations.bsb: Do I say this from a human perspective? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?
translations.kjv: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?
translations.asv: Do I speak these things after the manner of men? or saith not the law also the same?
